evidence_levels.label: pipeline_discriminative
evidence_levels.maximum_wording: supports or weighs against one bounded pipeline mechanism

evidence_levels.label: bounded_sensor_dependence
evidence_levels.maximum_wording: intact signal clears every registered train-only corruption and prior by the preregistered practical margin and paired uncertainty gate on the diagnostic partition

evidence_levels.label: brain_origin_review_eligible
evidence_levels.maximum_wording: eligible for separate Loop 35 review after synchronized peripheral controls and fresh prospective evidence

hypotheses.label: fixed_tiny_ctc_recipe_feasibility_or_optimization_failure
hypotheses.support_pattern: infeasible alignment or frozen-recipe tiny-fit failure with persistent blank loss or gradient pathology
hypotheses.against_pattern: all items feasible and the same frozen recipe reliably fits a tiny train-only subset
hypotheses.smallest_falsifier: static feasibility plus one separately registered tiny-fit sanity check
hypotheses.maximum_claim: the exact local recipe fails not that CTC is unsuitable

hypotheses.label: sensor_or_trial_quality_insufficiency
hypotheses.support_pattern: registered quality floors fail and simple and sequence probes also fail
hypotheses.against_pattern: quality floors pass and stable task-locked probes survive corruption controls
hypotheses.smallest_falsifier: train-only channel and trial quality audit paired with one simple probe
hypotheses.maximum_claim: this slice fails declared quality floors not that S21 lacks neural information

hypotheses.label: timing_or_preprocessing_information_mismatch
hypotheses.support_pattern: off-center train-only time profile or declared paired transform contrast isolates sensitivity
hypotheses.against_pattern: centered profile and paired transform agreement under the same split and probe
hypotheses.smallest_falsifier: frozen nonwrapping time-shift profile and one declared paired transform
hypotheses.maximum_claim: the local pipeline is timing or transform sensitive not that one transform is biologically correct

hypotheses.label: stable_but_nonseparable_representation
hypotheses.support_pattern: stable fit dynamics while simple and sequence probes fail intact versus corrupted controls on disjoint train-only check rows
hypotheses.against_pattern: a simple task-locked probe succeeds while continuous CTC fails
hypotheses.smallest_falsifier: one frozen shared check bundle containing simple and sequence probes
hypotheses.maximum_claim: this representation and probe combination is not separable at the measured scale

hypotheses.label: prior_dominated_task_regime
hypotheses.support_pattern: intact signal clears registered corruptions but fails the frozen practical margin or paired uncertainty gate against a train-only no-signal prior
hypotheses.against_pattern: intact signal clears the preregistered practical margin and paired uncertainty gate against the prior and every frozen corruption on the same check rows
hypotheses.smallest_falsifier: shared frozen intact corruption and prior predictions on one train-only check partition
hypotheses.maximum_claim: sensor evidence is weaker than the prior on this diagnostic partition

hypotheses.label: data_quantity_or_sentence_diversity_insufficiency
hypotheses.support_pattern: fit succeeds while check error improves across nested unique-sentence prefixes seed dispersion shrinks and no plateau appears
hypotheses.against_pattern: stable fit and check behavior reaches an early plateau insensitive to additional unique rows
hypotheses.smallest_falsifier: nested train-only unique-sentence curve with fixed seeds and one frozen check partition
hypotheses.maximum_claim: the observed 55-row range is non-saturated not that more data will necessarily create advantage

orthogonal_claim_threat.why_orthogonal: This threat bounds interpretation of a positive sensor result rather than explaining the current model failure.
